name: Tomodachi wa Koneko
source:
Yukine, who runs a bakery, makes bread for the "local cat" who goes to the store every morning.

This is the story of a baker and a "local cat".

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22659]Freem![/url]]
translation:
经营一家面包店的Yukine为每天早上去商店的“当地猫”制作面包。

这是一个面包师和一只“土猫”的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22659]Freem！[/url]]
